source: registered sparse observed 500ms public-trade bars, January-June 2023

information_unit.boundary: prior completed two-hour observed-trade high or low frozen at first attempt
information_unit.attempt: breach-direction five-second turnover z>=2 and completed five-second close back inside the same frozen boundary
information_unit.rearm: a later completed one-minute close inside the frozen boundary
information_unit.cluster: three distinct absorption attempts within 30 minutes of the first

action.side: fade the repeatedly absorbed boundary after the third attempt
action.entry: first observed 500ms bucket after fixed 500ms activation
action.stop: one tick beyond maximum causal cluster excursion
action.state_loss: completed one-minute close beyond cluster extreme
